result.summary: The image shows a wide two-lane roadway with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the crossing distance is relatively long without a median refuge or active signalization visible.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross two lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Lack of Active Warning
hazards.description: There are no visible flashing beacons or signals to alert drivers to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane area to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated amber LEDs to the crossing signs to increase driver yielding rates.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and wide sidewalks on both sides of a multi-lane one-way street. Traffic is controlled by overhead signals with 'No Turn on Red' restrictions, though the crossing distance remains significant for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street may block the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway, upstream of the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and wide, well-maintained sidewalks. The environment is generally pedestrian-friendly, though the wide roadway width and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions increase exposure during crossing.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire roadway width without a refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Large corner radius
hazards.description: The wide curve at the corner may allow vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a standard urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and well-maintained sidewalks. While basic infrastructure like traffic lights and curb ramps are present, the lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals and the relatively wide roadway suggest areas for safety improvements.

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: While traffic lights are present, dedicated pedestrian signal heads are not clearly visible, which may lead to confusion for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Potential for high vehicle speeds
hazards.description: The straight, relatively wide roadway may encourage higher speeds than appropriate for an urban pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Ensure high-visibility pedestrian signals with countdown timers are installed at all crossing points.
